content: Grade 1: the child must turn 6 years old on or before 31 May of the admission year to be eligible.
Grade 2: the child must turn 7 years old on or before 31 May of the admission year to be eligible.
Grade 3: the child must turn 8 years old on or before 31 May of the admission year to be eligible.
All applicants for Grade 2 and above must pass a baseline entrance test conducted by school coordinators before registration fee payment.
